newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Volvo sees 90 bln skr cars '97 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Volvo sees 90 bln skr cars '97 turnover.

text.p: Swedish vehicle maker Volvo said on Tuesday it expected to achieve 1997 turnover for its car division of around 90 billion crowns, compared with 1996 turnover of 83.59 billion crowns.
Volvo Cars Managing Director Tuve Johansson told a news conference Volvo's product mix was now centring on more expensive cars.
Volvo on Tuesday reported first half turnover for its car division of 48.16 billion crowns, a 21 percent increase on the same 1996 period.
"The product mix is moving towards more expensive cars. I can say already that turnover for the year will be around 90 billion crowns," Johansson added.
